summary: Backend-only validation of the 'Candidate has no attribute education' fix and defensive validation helpers (safe_int/safe_string/safe_list/clean_previous_companies) in /app/backend/server.py. Created /app/backend/tests/test_cv_upload_resilience.py with 20 tests covering: (1) unit tests for all 5 helper functions including edge cases (None, empty, alt keys, garbage types, 'X anos' strings, +suffix), (2) introspection of Candidate Pydantic model verifying 'education' is NOT in model_fields and not a hasattr on instances, (3) end-to-end simulation of the upload flow's defensive Candidate construction with messy parsed_data (None email, '10 anos' years_experience, non-list languages, previous_companies with alt keys / empty dicts / non-dicts) confirming NO exception is raised, (4) DocumentParser.extract_text_from_bytes round-trip on an in-memory reportlab-generated PDF, and (5) integration tests against the public URL: POST /api/candidates/upload-resume with a real PDF (200, status in {success, partial_success, duplicate_*}, no 'education' in body) and with an unsupported .txt (200 + status=failed, no AttributeError). Backend logs confirm 4 upload-resume calls returned 200 OK with no AttributeError traces. 20/20 tests PASSED.

minor.issue: Embedding generation logs continuous 401 from the embedding API (expected per problem statement). Result is still 200 with status='partial_success' and warning 'Búsqueda semántica no disponible para este candidato'. Not blocking but should be tracked when the API key is restored.

The batch processor in server.py around line 1555 still constructs Candidate WITHOUT the defensive helpers (raw parsed_data.get(...) values are passed for years_experience, skills, languages, and PreviousCompany(**pc) is built without clean_previous_company). The synchronous upload-resume path was hardened but the BATCH path can still raise the same class of errors for the same malformed CV. Recommend reusing safe_int/safe_string/safe_list/clean_previous_companies in process_cv_job.

action_items: Apply the same defensive validation (safe_int, safe_string, safe_list, clean_previous_companies) inside process_cv_job() in server.py (~line 1555) so batch uploads inherit the same resilience as the single-file endpoint.

Optional: add an integration test using a real two-column Canva-style PDF to exercise _detect_columns / _extract_text_multi_column in document_parser.py (current PDF was single-column due to reportlab limitation).
Optional: surface a clearer warning when years_experience is unparseable (currently silently becomes None).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 4300+ lines - should be split into routers (candidates, jobs, auth, search, smart_folders, exports). File-size guideline (<700) is far exceeded.

Defensive helpers (safe_int/safe_string/safe_list/clean_previous_companies) are duplicated logic that lives in server.py; recommend moving them to a shared module (e.g. data_validators.py) so they can be reused by process_cv_job and future ingestion paths.

process_cv_job() still does `PreviousCompany(**pc) for pc in parsed_data.get('previous_companies', []) if isinstance(pc, dict)` which will raise on missing required fields - same root cause as the original 'education' regression class.

create_version receives parsed_snapshot built from candidate.* attrs (line 1260-1274). Now that 'education' was removed, double-check there are no other model_dump consumers (cv_version_service, export_service, embedding_service) that still expect education in the snapshot.
seed_data_creation: Created 1-2 TEST_ candidates during integration upload tests (TEST_resilience_cv.pdf). Soft duplicate suggestion may have been generated on re-runs. Cleanup not performed - main agent may want to soft-delete those if they appear in QA dashboards.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_cv_upload_resilience.py -v`. Tests need `reportlab` (already installed) to generate the in-memory PDF. The integration test logs in /var/log/supervisor/backend.*.log show '200 OK' for upload-resume and zero 'education' AttributeError traces. The embedding service still returns 401 which produces a 'partial_success' status - this is expected and the test allows it. If the main agent extends the defensive helpers to process_cv_job, add an analogous batch test posting to /api/candidates/upload-batch (if exposed).
rca of the issue: Original RCA confirmed: removing `candidate.education` reference at server.py line 1269 (parsed_snapshot dict) eliminated the AttributeError. The Candidate Pydantic model in /app/backend/models.py never declared an `education` field, so any attribute access on it raised AttributeError. Fix verified by (a) model_fields introspection, (b) hasattr check, (c) end-to-end POST returning 200 with status='success'/'partial_success' and no 'education' substring in the response body. Defensive helpers prevent a related class of failure when AI parser returns 'years_experience: "10 anos"' or previous_companies with alternate keys ('company'/'position' vs 'company_name'/'title'); confirmed all helpers behave correctly for None, empty strings, garbage types, lists with mixed/invalid entries, etc.
